A.claim: Beal is FALSE over the Gaussian integers: (-2+i)^3 + (-2-i)^3 = (1+i)^4, with exponents (3,3,4) all >= 3 and bases sharing no Gaussian prime (norms 5, 5, 2). Therefore Beal cannot be proved from unique factorisation alone; any valid proof must use the total ordering of Z or the ramification of rational primes.

B.claim: Kernel-checked account of what remains: residual_of_counterexample — any Beal counterexample yields one with exponents in {4} U odd primes, not (4,4,4), not (3,3,3), exactly one even base, C even => not (x,y)=(4,4), no cancellation, pairwise coprime distinct bases; beal_of_no_residual — refuting every ResidualShape proves Beal.
